# SC-002 reference corpus (feature 031): terminal output from AI CLIs and command-line tools,
# read by `crates/micold-core/tests/link_corpus.rs`.
#
# Format
#
# - A line starting with `#` is a comment. A blank line ends an entry.
# - An entry is a run of output lines, each printed with a real line break after it. Every entry is
#   read on its own, between two empty rows.
# - An expected link is delimited inline by ⟦ and ⟧. The delimiters are not part of the output.
#   Every other cell of the entry is no link: that is how the scheme-less addresses below are
#   checked.
# - `@wrap <width>` on its own line soft-wraps the output line after it into rows <width> cells wide,
#   as a terminal that narrow does. Every row but the last soft-wraps into the next.
# - `@hard` on its own line starts an entry holding one address a program broke itself, with real
#   line breaks. Its piece on the first row is expected there alone, when that piece is well-formed.
#
# Every char is one cell: wide characters and their spacer cells are covered by the unit tests in
# `link/line.rs`, not here.
